At the bottom of the {wiki:Desert Dungeon}, in the Jakundaf desert, there is a box guarded by a {creature:Fire Devil} with a bag containing a {item:Power Ring}, a {item:Panpipes} and 2 {item:Small Amethyst|Small Amethysts}. Go down to the bottom of the dungeon and climb back up by another path to the locked door where the treasure is.
Know how to reach the exit portal of the {wiki:Vocation Quest}: it is the only safe way out of the Desert Dungeon.
obtained from the hollow stone near the entrance (step 1)
The Desert Dungeon is a dangerous place and there may be creatures lured there by other players.
Do not go in without the {item:Key 4055}: without it you can't open the treasure door.

The {wiki:Desert Dungeon} lies beneath the **Jakundaf Desert**, **west** of Venore and **south** of Kazordoon (between Venore and Thais). Walk to the desert; the dungeon entrance is a {item:Loose Stone Pile} in the middle of the desert, near the temple of {npc:Adrenius}.
The entrance to the Desert Dungeon
Next to the {wiki:Desert Dungeon} entrance, **use** the {item:Stone (Long)|hollow stone} to get the {item:Key 4055}.
Go back to the Desert Dungeon entrance, use the {item:Shovel} and go in.
You can't leave the way you came in. Before you go in, make sure you know how to reach the exit portal of the {wiki:Vocation Quest}.
Go down **5 staircases** in a row to the bottom. You will find {creature:Spider|Spiders}.
West and south, go up one floor
Follow the path around to the **west** and then **south** (you may meet a {creature:Bonelord}) and go up one floor.
Path at the bottom of the dungeon to the way up
Follow the path **northwest** (a few more {creature:Spider|Spiders}), pass the {wiki:Desert Dungeon Library} and use the {item:Rope} on the hole to go up.
Path northwest, past the library, to the rope hole
Go up one more floor with the rope
Use the {item:Rope} again to go up one more floor.
On this floor, follow the path **south** and go up one more floor.
Path south to the way up
Follow the path **southeast** to the locked door. Open it with the {item:Key 4055}. Inside there is a {creature:Fire Devil} — kill it.
Path southeast to the door and the quest box
The {creature:Fire Devil} attacks with fire; bring potions.
Open the quest box: it has a {item:Bag} with a {item:Power Ring}, a {item:Panpipes} and 2 {item:Small Amethyst|Small Amethysts}.
Power Ring, Panpipes and 2 Small Amethysts

You can't leave through the hole you came in by. Go back the same way to the bottom of the dungeon (the {creature:Spider|Spiders} floor, where you arrived after the 5 descents): go back down the floors you climbed and go down through the two holes where you used the {item:Rope}.
Leaving the Desert Dungeon through the teleport

From the spider floor, follow the short path of the {wiki:The Desert Dungeon Quest|Desert Dungeon Quest} (Vocation Quest) to the {item:Gate of Expertise}:
- Go **north**, turn **east** as soon as you can and follow the cave **south** to the stairs; go up.
- Go **west** to another staircase and go up (**do not** go down the hole to the south with the warning sign).
- Go **south** and go up the next staircase.
- Go **east** and **north** (there is a hole: **do not** go down), then **east** and **north** again to the last staircase; go up.
Next to the Gate of Expertise is the **exit teleport**: step into it and you appear next to {npc:Adrenius}, in the temple in the Jakundaf Desert. From there, head out to the surface of the desert and walk back to Venore (to the east).
Spider floor: north, east and south to the stairs
Only go up the stairs to the west; do not go down the hole
Head northeast to the last stairs and the Gate of Expertise
In the Desert Dungeon there are holes with no rope spot on the other side: do not go down any hole that is not in these instructions.
Also known as the Fire Devil Quest.
